propositions: A code-review finding raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on a later patchset reaches no consumer, causing defects like the assert advisory that vanished between PS2 and PS3 on change 1867
Unresolved findings must be carried forward across patchsets with state classification (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) to prevent loss of valid findings
Carried findings must be injected post-Pass-1 into the merge_findings workflow step with an additive standing sub-object tracking origin_revision, origin_decision, and state
A standing finding's posture must never be raised above its origin_decision, even if blocking_enabled or block_threshold conditions change between patchsets
Classification of prior findings into carry-forward states requires comparing region hashes against the prior payload's deps map, with REGION_UNKNOWN defaulting to still-present for safety
Carry-forward is one-shot: a finding already carrying a standing object from a prior patchset is marked withdrawn and not re-carried
